name: search_games
description: Search the TheGamesDB video-game database by title. Returns matching games with platform name, release date, players, rating, and a short overview. Example: search_games({ name: "zelda", limit: 10 })

name.description: Game title or keyword to search for, e.g. "zelda", "halo", "final fantasy"

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 15)

_apiKey.description: Optional TheGamesDB API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx platform key.

name: get_game
description: Get full metadata for a single game by its TheGamesDB id, including the front boxart image URL. Example: get_game({ id: 108139 })

_apiKey.description: Optional TheGamesDB API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx platform key.

name: list_platforms
description: List all gaming platforms known to TheGamesDB (id, name, alias). Useful for resolving platform ids. Example: list_platforms({})

_apiKey.description: Optional TheGamesDB API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx platform key.

name: list_genres
description: List all game genres known to TheGamesDB (id, name). Useful for resolving genre ids. Example: list_genres({})

_apiKey.description: Optional TheGamesDB API key. Omit to use the shared Pipeworx platform key.
